A Relic Reborn.Zenith:
Buy 3 Thavnairian Mist from Auriana in Mor Dhona.
Trade the mist and your Relic weapon at the Furnace next to Gerolt.
A Relic Reborn.Atma:
Finish 'Up in Arms' to unlock Atma.
Equip your Zenith weapon and collect all 12 Atma from FATEs.
Bring the Atma and your Zenith weapon to Jalzahn.
A Relic Reborn.Animus:
Finish 'Trials of the Braves' to meet G'jusana.
Buy and finish all 9 books, one at a time, with your Atma weapon equipped.
Return to Jalzahn.
A Relic Reborn.Novus:
Unlock Sphere Scrolls through Hubairtin and buy 3 Superior Enchanted Ink.
Fill your scroll with 75 Alexandrite and 75 successful materia infusions.
Bring the filled scroll to Jalzahn.
A Relic Reborn.Nexus:
Finish 'Mmmmmm, Soulglazed Relics' and have Jalzahn soulglaze your Novus weapon.
Equip the weapon and earn Light from duties. Check it with the Zodiac Glass.
Return to Jalzahn when the weapon is full.
A Relic Reborn.Zodiac:
Complete the four repeatable sub-quests for their turn-ins.
Gather the remaining items and HQ crafts listed under Requirements.
Turn everything in to Gerolt for your first weapon, or Jalzahn for later weapons.
A Relic Reborn.Zeta:
Finish 'Rise and Shine' to meet Remon.
Buy and awaken 12 Mahatma, one at a time, by running duties with your weapon equipped.
Return to Jalzahn.

Anima Weapons.Animated:
Get one Luminous Crystal from FATEs in each Heavensward zone, or trade in a Zodiac Zeta.
Exchange them for the Astral and Umbral Nodules at Syndony in Mor Dhona.
Hand both nodules to Ardashir.
Anima Weapons.Awoken:
Accept 'Toughening Up'.
Clear the 10 listed dungeons in order. Equip your Animated weapon before using each exit portal.
Return to Ardashir in Azys Lla.
Anima Weapons.Anima:
Collect the four types of Unidentifiable items and the four crafts.
Trade them to Cristiana in Mor Dhona for the four quest items.
Deliver those items to Gerolt.
Anima Weapons.Hyperconductive:
Accept 'Finding Your Voice'.
Buy 5 Aether Oil with Poetics and turn them in.
Anima Weapons.Reconditioned:
Collect Umbrite and Crystal Sand.
Have Ulan in Idyllshire make Refined Crystal Sand, then allocate your weapon stats.
Anima Weapons.Sharpened:
Accept 'Future Proof' and collect 50 Singing Cluster.
Trade them to Blamprest in Idyllshire, then deliver to Ardashir.
Anima Weapons.Complete:
Clear the three Hard dungeons for 'Born Again Anima' as the matching job.
Equip the weapon to earn aetheric density. Check it with the Enhanced Anima Glass.
Trade 15 Pneumite for a Newborn Soulstone and finish the upgrade.
Anima Weapons.Lux:
Finish 'Body and Soul' and 'Words of Wisdom' if needed.
Clear the 12 Hard trials in their listed groups for 'Best Friends Forever'.
Buy 1 Archaic Enchanted Ink and turn it in.

Eureka Weapons.Base:
Get the Antiquated weapon from your level 70 job quest.
Farm in Eureka Anemos and exchange Anemos Crystals for Protean Crystals at Gerolt.
Trade the weapon and 100 Protean Crystals to Gerolt.
Eureka Weapons.Base +1:
Gather 400 Protean Crystals in Eureka Anemos.
Trade them and the base weapon to Gerolt.
Eureka Weapons.Base +2:
Gather 800 Protean Crystals in Eureka Anemos.
Trade them and the +1 weapon to Gerolt.
Eureka Weapons.Anemos:
Get 3 Pazuzu's Feathers from Pazuzu or the Expedition Birdwatcher.
Bring the feathers and your +2 weapon to Gerolt on the matching job.
Eureka Weapons.Pagos:
Unlock the vitiated aether kettle in Eureka Pagos.
Fill it by defeating enemies and exchange the charges at the Crystal Forge.
Trade 5 Frosted Protean Crystals and your Anemos weapon to Gerolt.
Eureka Weapons.Pagos +1:
Exchange kettle charges for 10 Frosted Protean Crystals at the Crystal Forge.
Get 500 Pagos Crystals from Notorious Monsters and turn everything in to Gerolt.
Eureka Weapons.Elemental:
Collect 16 Frosted Protean Crystals and 5 Louhi's Ice in Eureka Pagos.
Trade them and your Pagos +1 weapon to Gerolt.
Eureka Weapons.Elemental +1:
Unlock 10 unique Logos Actions in Eureka Pyros.
Collect 150 Pyros Crystals and trade them with your Elemental weapon.
Eureka Weapons.Elemental +2:
Unlock 20 unique Logos Actions in Eureka Pyros.
Collect 200 Pyros Crystals and trade them with your Elemental +1 weapon.
Eureka Weapons.Pyros:
Unlock 30 unique Logos Actions.
Collect 300 Pyros Crystals and 5 Penthesilea's Flames and turn them in.
Eureka Weapons.Hydatos:
Collect 50 Hydatos Crystals from Notorious Monsters in Eureka Hydatos.
Trade them and your Pyros weapon to Gerolt.
Eureka Weapons.Hydatos +1:
Collect 100 Hydatos Crystals.
Trade them and your Hydatos weapon to Gerolt.
Eureka Weapons.Base (Physeos):
Collect 100 Hydatos Crystals.
Trade them and your Hydatos +1 weapon to Gerolt.
Eureka Weapons.Eureka:
Collect 100 Hydatos Crystals and 5 Crystalline Scales.
Earn the scales from 'Crystalline Provenance', then turn both materials in to Gerolt.
Eureka Weapons.Physeos:
Earn 100 Eureka Fragments in the Baldesion Arsenal.
Trade them and your Eureka weapon to Gerolt for its elemental bonus.

Resistance Weapons.Resistance:
Finish the Save the Queen opening quests through 'Fire in the Forge' for your first weapon.
For another job, trade 4 Thavnairian Scalepowder in 'Resistance Is (Not) Futile'.
Resistance Weapons.Augmented:
Accept 'For Want of a Memory'.
Farm 20 each of Tortured, Sorrowful and Harrowing Memories in Bozja or Heavensward FATEs.
Turn the memories in for the upgrade.
Resistance Weapons.Recollection:
Accept 'The Will to Resist'.
Collect and turn in 6 Bitter Memories from synced Heavensward dungeons, Leveling Roulette or Bozja.
Resistance Weapons.Law's Order:
Reach Resistance Rank 10, clear Castrum Lacus Litore, and finish the story through Delubrum Reginae.
Collect 15 Loathsome Memories and turn them in for 'Change of Arms'.
Resistance Weapons.Augmented Law's Order:
Once: complete 'The Resistance Remembers' with 18 Haunting and 18 Vexatious Memories.
Per weapon: turn in 15 Timeworn Artifacts for 'A New Path of Resistance'.
Resistance Weapons.Blade's:
Once: unlock Zadnor and finish its three material quests.
Per weapon: collect 15 Raw Emotions and turn them in for 'Irresistible'.

Manderville Weapons.Manderville:
Finish the Hildibrand story through 'The Imperfect Gentleman'.
Buy 3 Manderium Meteorites from Jubrunnah and turn them in.
Manderville Weapons.Amazing:
Finish 'Generational Bonding' and accept 'The Next Mander-level'.
Buy 3 Complementary Chondrites from Jubrunnah and turn them in.
Manderville Weapons.Majestic:
Finish 'Not from Around Here' and accept 'In Need of Adjustment'.
Buy 3 Amplifying Achondrites from Jubrunnah, turn them in, and pick your stats.
Manderville Weapons.Mandervillous:
Finish 'Gentlemen at Heart' and accept 'Positively Mandervillous'.
Buy 3 Cosmic Crystallites from Jubrunnah, turn them in, and pick your stats.

Phantom Weapons.Penumbrae:
Once: unlock Occult Crescent and collect 3 of each of the six Demiatma.
Per weapon: buy 3 Arcanite from Ermina and trade it to Dodokkuli.
Phantom Weapons.Umbrae:
Once: turn in the materials for 'Keeping the Old Ways Alive' and fill the Aetherwell Array from roulettes.
Per weapon: trade 3 Waxing Arcanite and your Penumbrae weapon to Dodokkuli.
Phantom Weapons.Obscurum:
Once: turn in the materials for 'Timeworn Techniques' and collect 1,200 Crystal Paste from duties.
Per weapon: trade 3 Waning Arcanite and your Umbrae weapon to Dodokkuli.
Phantom Weapons.Eclipticum:
Once: unlock North Horn, finish the 'Under No Illusion' turn-ins, and collect 100 of each Phantom Dispeller.
Per weapon: trade 3 Ecliptic Arcanite and your Obscurum weapon to Dodokkuli.
Phantom Weapons.Occultum:
Finish 'Final Phantasm' to convert your Eclipticum weapon.
Bring later jobs' Eclipticum weapons to Dodokkuli for the same conversion.
Finish 'All Too Fleeting' to close out the story.

Lucis Tools.Mastercraft: Complete your level 50 crafting or gathering class quest for the base tool.
Lucis Tools.Supra:
Bring your base tool, 2 Fieldcraft Demimateria III and 1 Mastercraft Demimateria to Talan in Mor Dhona.
[[Crafters]]
Craft the class-specific turn-in listed under Requirements.
[[Gatherers]]
Gather 30 Antumbral Rock as Miner or 30 Redolent Log as Botanist for a Talan Seal.
[[Fisher]]
Catch Olgoi-Khorkhoi during Heat Waves by mooching a Storm Rider.
Lucis Tools.Lucis:
Trade your Supra tool, 5 Moonstones and your class turn-in to Talan.
[[Crafters]]
Craft the class-specific final item listed under Requirements.
[[Gatherers]]
Gather the class materials for a Talan Mastery Seal.
[[Fisher]]
Collect 15 Glacier Crystals and 10 Gigant Clams for a Talan Mastery Seal.

Skysteel Tools.Skysteel:
Finish 'Mislaid Plans' and open the prototype coffer on your chosen class.
Buy other classes' base tools from Denys for 80,000 gil each.
Skysteel Tools.Skysteel +1:
[[Crafters]]
Craft 20 first-tier items and turn them in to Denys.
[[Gatherers]]
Gather 340 first-tier items and 120 hidden items, then return to Denys.
[[Fisher]]
Catch 40 Thinker's Coral at the Thaliak River and return to Denys.
Skysteel Tools.Dragonsung:
Turn in the class items to Denys and finish 'In Everyone's Best Interests' once.
[[Crafters]]
Craft 30 second-tier items.
[[Gatherers]]
Gather 510 second-tier items and 180 hidden items.
[[Fisher]]
Catch 60 Dragonspine at Dragonspit.
Skysteel Tools.Augmented Dragonsung:
Accept 'Ever Skyward' from Nimie. Equip the current tool when gathering or fishing.
[[Crafters]]
Craft and exchange collectables for 90 gobbiegoo, then hand it to Nimie.
[[Gatherers]]
Gather 500 third-tier items for 50 gobbiegoo. Give that and 180 hidden items to Nimie.
[[Fisher]]
Catch 60 Petal Shell at Plum Spring. Exchange them for 6 Fisher's Gobbiegoo and give it to Nimie.
Skysteel Tools.Skysung:
Accept 'The Tools of Tomorrow' from Nimie and equip the current tool when gathering or fishing.
[[Crafters]]
Craft and exchange collectables for 105 highly viscous gobbiegoo. Give it to Nimie.
[[Gatherers]]
Gather 600 fourth-tier items for 60 highly viscous gobbiegoo. Give that and 200 hidden items to Nimie.
[[Fisher]]
Catch 70 Allagan Hunter at the Alpha Quadrant. Trade for 7 Highly Viscous Fisher's Gobbiegoo and give it to Nimie.
Skysteel Tools.Skybuilders':
Accept 'The Pinnacle of Possibility' from Emeny. Exchange your turn-ins at Spanner, then deliver the parts to Emeny.
[[Crafters]]
Use the Expert Recipe to make enough collectables for 60 oddly delicate parts.
[[Gatherers]]
Gather 36 high-collectability items and 750 Diadem items for the two kinds of parts.
[[Fisher]]
Catch 50 each of Flintstrike and Pickled Pom at max collectability for the rod and reel parts.

Resplendent Tools.Resplendent:
[[Crafters]]
Buy Material A with Purple Crafters' Scrips.
Craft components A, B, and C in order, trading each batch to Limbeth for the next material.
Trade 60 Final Material for the tool.
[[Gatherers]]
Record 220 unique Miner items or 340 unique Botanist items to earn the matching tool.
[[Fisher]]
Record 1,140 unique fish to earn the rod.

Splendorous Tools.Splendorous:
Finish 'An Original Improvement' and open the coffer on your chosen class.
Buy other classes' base tools from Quinnana for 750 scrips each.
Splendorous Tools.Augmented:
Accept 'A Dedicated Tool' and turn in the materials in the Crystarium.
[[Crafters]]
Craft first-tier collectables using Select materials.
[[Gatherers]]
Equip the tool and gather 60 collectables plus 180 hidden shards.
[[Fisher]]
Equip the rod and catch 30 each of Platinum Seahorse and Clavekeeper.
Splendorous Tools.Crystalline:
Accept 'An Adaptive Tool' and turn in the materials in the Crystarium.
[[Crafters]]
Craft second-tier collectables using Select materials.
[[Gatherers]]
Equip the tool and gather 70 collectables plus 210 hidden crystals.
[[Fisher]]
Equip the rod and catch 40 each of Mirror Image and Spangled Pirarucu.
Splendorous Tools.Chora-Zoi's:
Accept 'A Tool of Her Own' and turn in the materials in the Crystarium.
[[Crafters]]
Craft third-tier collectables using Select materials.
[[Gatherers]]
Equip the tool and gather 70 collectables plus 210 hidden Custom Crystals.
[[Fisher]]
Equip the rod and catch 40 each of Gold Dustfish and Forgiven Melancholy.
Splendorous Tools.Brilliant:
Accept 'A Tool without Compare' and turn in the materials in the Crystarium.
[[Crafters]]
Craft fourth-tier collectables using Select materials.
[[Gatherers]]
Equip the tool and collect 70 collectables plus 210 Brilliant Clusters.
[[Fisher]]
Equip the rod and catch 40 each of Oil Slick and Gonzalo's Grace.
Splendorous Tools.Vrandtic:
Accept 'A Tool for the Ages' and turn in the materials in the Crystarium.
[[Crafters]]
Craft fifth-tier collectables with the Expert Recipe.
[[Gatherers]]
Equip the tool and collect the items and 220 Inspirational Clusters. Use Aetherial Reduction or exchange at Quinnana.
[[Fisher]]
Equip the rod and catch 43 each of Deadwood Shadow and Ronkan Bullion.
Splendorous Tools.Lodestar:
Accept 'Stand Tool, My Friend' and turn in the materials in the Crystarium.
[[Crafters]]
Craft sixth-tier collectables with the Expert Recipe.
[[Gatherers]]
Equip the tool and collect the items and 220 Nightforged Clusters. Use Aetherial Reduction or exchange at Quinnana.
[[Fisher]]
Equip the rod and catch 43 each of Little Bounty and Saint Fathric's Face.

Cosmic Tools.Cosmic:
Get your prototype from 'A Cosmic Homecoming' or Researchingway.
Earn Types I–IV research data from Stellar Missions on the matching class.
Return to Researchingway for each upgrade.
Cosmic Tools.Stellar:
Run Stellar Missions on the matching class to earn Type V and top up Types I–IV.
Return to Researchingway for each upgrade.
Cosmic Tools.Hyper:
Run class A Stellar Missions for Type VI and top up earlier data types as needed.
Return to Researchingway for each upgrade.
Cosmic Tools.Stellar (final):
Earn Type VII and top up Types I–VI through Stellar Missions.
Return to Researchingway to finish the tool.

Eurekan Armor.Eureka Job Armor: Bring your Antiquated job armour and 50 Protean Crystals per piece to Gerolt in Eureka Anemos.
Eurekan Armor.Eureka Job Armor +1: Bring the base piece and 150 Protean Crystals to Gerolt in Eureka Anemos.
Eurekan Armor.Eureka Job Armor +2: Bring the +1 piece and 400 Protean Crystals to Gerolt in Eureka Anemos.
Eurekan Armor.Eureka Anemos Armor: Bring the +2 piece and 150 Anemos Crystals to Gerolt in Eureka Anemos.
Eurekan Armor.Elemental Armor: Gather Pyros Crystals and trade 40 per piece for Elemental armour in Eureka Pyros.
Eurekan Armor.Elemental Armor +1: Bring the base pieces and Hydatos Crystals to the armour vendor in Eureka Hydatos.
Eurekan Armor.Elemental Armor +2: Earn Eureka Fragments in the Baldesion Arsenal and trade them with your +1 pieces.

Resistance Armor.Bozjan Armor: Collect Bozjan Coins in the Southern Front and trade them to the Resistance Supplier.
Resistance Armor.Augmented Bozjan Armor:
Get the matching Bozjan Runner's Secret for each piece.
Trade the base piece and its Secret to the Resistance Supplier.
Resistance Armor.Law's Order: Collect Bozjan Gold Coins and buy Law's Order pieces from the Resistance Supplier.
Resistance Armor.Augmented Law's Order:
Get the slot-specific Runner's Plating from Delubrum Reginae (Savage) for the Orderly Runner's Secret.
Trade the Secret, the Law's Order piece and the matching Augmented Bozjan piece.
Resistance Armor.Blade's Armor: Collect Bozjan Platinum Coins in Zadnor and trade them for Blade's armour.

Phantom Armor.Arcanaut's Armor: Earn Enlightenment Silver Pieces in South Horn and trade 4,000 per piece for Arcanaut's armour.
Phantom Armor.Arcanaut's Armor +1:
For each piece, collect 3 Aetherspun Silver and 3 Aetherial Fixative.
Trade them with the base piece in South Horn.
Phantom Armor.Arcanaut's Armor +2:
For each piece, collect 3 Aetherspun Gold and 6 X-Fixative.
Trade them with the +1 piece in South Horn.
Phantom Armor.Phantom Vision: Earn Enlightenment Silver Obols in North Horn and trade 4,000 per piece for Phantom Vision armour.
Phantom Armor.Phantom Vision +1: Bring the base piece and 3 Final Final Fixative to the North Horn armorer, or trade a matching Arcanaut's +1 piece.
Phantom Armor.Phantom Vision +2: Bring the +1 piece and 4 Final Final Fixative to the North Horn armorer, or trade a matching Arcanaut's +2 piece.
Phantom Armor.Phantom Vision +3: Bring the +2 piece and 8 Final Final Fixative to the North Horn armorer.
